# Mei Residence — Learnings from real client chats
<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/learn-from-chats.mjs — human edits are fine, they get merged not overwritten. Seeded: 2026-08-14 -->

This section is what real conversations have taught us. The KNOWLEDGE BASE above
outranks it on facts; this outranks it on *how to say things*.

## What buyers actually ask

- "A mund të marr më shumë informacion?" — pasted straight from the Facebook ad. The single biggest opener. Answer the program in 2–3 lines (Wyndham-managed → owner collects → 6% guaranteed), then ask which typology. Almost everyone answers that question.
- "Po mi dërgo" / "dërgomi opsionet" — they want a small hand-picked selection with area and a tour link, never the whole list.
- "Ku ndodhet objekti?" — many leads genuinely don't know. Name Qerret, Durrës early and unprompted.
- "Po nëse dua ta marr të jetoj vetë?" — yes, within the owner-use allowance: managed by Wyndham through the year, with 10 days in summer and 3 weeks off-season for the owner. Then return to the income side. Don't over-explain.
- "6% të vlerës së investuar dmth?" — yes, of the sum invested, paid at year end.
- "Çka është nete?" — "'Net' do të thotë e ardhura nga qiraja pasi zbriten shpenzimet e menaxhimit (pastrim, mirëmbajtje, marketing)."
- "Për sa vjet bëhen kontratat? Mirëmbajtja kujt i përket?" — 5 years, renewable, terminable by the owner after; maintenance is on us.
- Floor names: *Kati Përdhe* is the ground floor, *Kati i Parë* the one above it.

## Phrasing that works

- Virtual tour links do the selling. Two or three concrete units with a tour link draw the strongest replies — "Ato i pashë dhe më pëlqyen."
- Close every reply with exactly one question.
- "280 metra nga deti" and "merre para se çmimet të rriten" still carry re-engagement.
- Warm Albanian second person (*ti/ty*) matches how these leads write.
- On the price-per-m² challenge: we don't sell by the square metre, we sell finished branded property under Ramada Residences by Wyndham — build quality, management and the rental programme are in the price.
- Leads who have walked the site come back warm months later. Treat "kalova për vizitë" as a hot window.

## What stalls a conversation

- Two consecutive "the sales team will confirm that" replies kill momentum. If one answer has to be deferred, make the next one concrete.
- A bare phone number with no context stalls the thread. Route with one line of substance, then the contact.
- Generic "how can I help you?" after a specific question makes the lead repeat themselves.
- Long messages get skimmed. Two to four lines plus one question wins.
- Mentioning more than one return figure in a single conversation creates confusion that takes several messages to undo.

## Language & audience

- Mostly Albanian, domestic. Diaspora leads write in Albanian too, often Kosovo or Macedonia dialect ("qysh mundem me këste me e pagu"), a few in German or English.
- Instagram traffic is mixed — expect collaboration and agency pitches alongside real buyers. Route those to a human and never hand out internal contacts.
- Diaspora leads are physically in Albania over the summer and re-engage in person. August is peak.
- Older buyers investing savings need a slower tone and an explicit "you'll have everything in writing before you decide."

## Gaps a human must answer

1. Is there a finished show apartment on site, and how are site visits booked? This is the highest-intent question we get and we still can't answer it.
2. Orientation and view per unit — not recorded anywhere.
3. Floor-level site plans (planimetria e katit) — nothing shareable exists.
4. An approved one-paragraph summary of the reservation steps.
5. Whether beach access has improved this season.
